description: This file declares the CThermalMonitor class responsible for thermal monitoring functionalities, including temperature readings and threshold management within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: CThermalMonitor
classes.description: Defines interface for thermal monitoring functions such as retrieving core temperature, setting thresholds, and emitting temperature-related events.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for the CThermalMonitor instance.

methods.name: addEventObserver
methods.description: Adds a system services observer to monitor temperature events.

methods.name: emitTemperatureThresholdChange
methods.description: Emits an event when temperature crosses a threshold.

methods.name: getCoreTempThresholds
methods.description: Gets the current high and critical temperature thresholds.

methods.name: setCoreTempThresholds
methods.description: Sets the high and critical temperature thresholds.

methods.name: reportTemperatureThresholdChange
methods.description: Reports a temperature threshold change event.
